name: Hitron Technologies Inc.
summary: Hitron Technologies Inc. produces and sells telecommunications products in the United States, Taiwan, and internationally. It operates through System Integration and Manufacturing segments. The company offers 5G; cable modems and gateways; fiber ONT/ONUs; wireless networking solutions; and coax network testing tools.
